Otherwise, contact a poison control center without delay. U.S. residents can reach the poison control center at 1-800-222-1222. If you miss a dose of your medication, take it as soon as you remember. However, if you have already eaten, skip the missed dose and proceed with your next dose at the regular scheduled time. Store ampules in their foil pouches at room temperature, away from heat and light, until they are ready for use. Do not store them in the bathroom.
